description: Reconstructs complete data lineage for an S3 artifact from compute job history. Returns a W3C PROV-DM JSON-LD graph, a Markdown lineage summary, and a gap report identifying chain breaks. Foundational for reproducibility pre-flight checks.

artifact_uri.description: S3 URI of the artifact to trace lineage for

lookback_days.description: How many days back to search job history
